posts.text: Nope, that’s not what I was saying — listen to what I actually say — and this clip is from Summer 2025 after @AlexThomp and I wrote our book, almost all of which was reported AFTER the 2024 election. The framing is inaccurate.
posts.summary: Defends accuracy of reporting, disputes framing of clip
